correctness.rationale: For p≡1 mod3 with p||n and two distinct q||n in a primitive order-three class modulo p, both σ(q²) factors are multiples of p, forcing p|R(n). For p≤Y=L^(1/3), L=loglog X, the additive function f_p counting such q||n has mean A_p=L/(p-1)+O(log L) and variance proxy B_p²=L/(p-1)+O(log L), uniformly via a split at exp(L²), Siegel–Walfisz and partial summation. Turán–Kubilius bounds insufficient witnesses by O(Xp/L), union over growing outer primes O(XL^(-1/3)). CRT avoidance of p||n has density ∏(1-(p-1)/p²) ≪_T1/sqrt(logY) by progression Mertens; period M=exp(o(logX)) negligible. Therefore fixed-T bound O_T(X/sqrt(logloglogX)). Independently computed σ(n²) from factorization and verified R(n)=1 counts 10,99,974 through 10,100,1000. Numerical counts are not the asymptotic proof.
